regions.name: Lake Assal
regions.quote: Inland populations can be found in Egypt (oases of Siwa and Al-Faiyum), Saudi Arabia (oases of Al-Hasa and Al-Kharj) and the salt lakes of the Afar Depression in Djibouti, including Lake Assal.
